categories.main_business_segments: TRS Information Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in software development, AI software products and services, big data software products and services, security products, and system integration. The company focuses on digital government, media, financial technology, public safety, open-source intelligence, and digital enterprises. It also has a growing overseas business segment targeting regions such as Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Latin America.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI technologies including large language models (LLMs), natural language processing (NLP), optical character recognition (OCR), and multi-modal data processing. It develops proprietary AI platforms such as the Tuotian (拓天) large model integrated platform and the Tuotian Chain intelligent agent platform, employing techniques like reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), model quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation. The company also integrates knowledge graphs and vector databases to enhance semantic search and AI applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies at central, provincial, and municipal levels, state-owned enterprises, financial institutions including major banks and regulatory bodies, media organizations, public safety departments, and defense institutions. The company serves industries such as digital government, media, finance, public security, and open-source intelligence, with a significant presence in China and expanding internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and multiple R&D centers in Beijing, Chengdu, and Guangzhou. It has expanded its international footprint through its wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong, targeting markets in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Latin America, and Belt and Road countries. Domestic operations cover northern, eastern, southern, central, and western China regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: TRS operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the software and AI technology supply chain, focusing on software product development, AI platform services, data processing, and customized AI solutions. It provides technology and data services directly to end customers including government and enterprise clients, rather than upstream hardware manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes AI technology innovation, especially in large model development, AI agent platforms, and multi-modal AI capabilities. It emphasizes deep vertical industry applications in finance, government, media, public safety, and open-source intelligence. R&D efforts focus on improving model precision, inference speed, and domain adaptation, as well as expanding data asset capabilities and AI engineering for scalable deployment. The company also invests in domestic hardware adaptation and global data collection to support AI model training and applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through software product sales, subscription-based cloud services, data services including API access and data sets, system integration projects, and customized AI solutions. The company also earns income from licensing, consulting, and expert advisory services. It offers tiered subscription accounts and charges based on data volume, API usage, project scope, and service duration.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: TRS is positioned as a leading Chinese AI and big data technology provider with strong proprietary technologies and deep vertical industry expertise. It competes with domestic and international AI and software firms in sectors such as digital government, financial technology, and public safety. The company holds significant market share in central government and state-owned enterprise sectors and is recognized among the top AI model enterprises in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, TRS reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 777 million, a slight decrease of 0.59% year-over-year. The company experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 94 million, impacted by goodwill impairment and increased R&D investment. Despite short-term profitability pressure, the company’s net assets grew by 23.06% to over RMB 4.1 billion. R&D expenditure increased to 43% of revenue, reflecting a strategic focus on long-term growth. Overseas revenue grew by 55.04%, reaching RMB 9.24 million.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TRS emphasizes its comprehensive AI technology stack, including proprietary large language models tailored for Chinese language and vertical industries. Its unique value lies in integrating high-quality, large-scale data assets with advanced AI algorithms and domain-specific knowledge graphs to deliver intelligent, scenario-based solutions. The company’s no-code AI agent platform lowers deployment barriers, enabling rapid AI adoption. Its strong government and enterprise client base, combined with deep industry expertise and domestic hardware adaptation, differentiates it in the competitive AI and big data market.
